note: Measured inventory of floats and burials. The gate fails when a count goes UP. Three of the four are not zero because this check cannot see intent: a stacked rock course rests on rock, a POI apron is meant to be underground, a canopy roof is meant to be in the air. **poiFloating is deliberately pinned at 0 and is NOT a measured value** -- a POI compound where EVERY mesh is clear of the ground has no benign reading, so baselining the 13 that appeared after the 2026-08-24 terrain reshape would have hidden the regression this gate exists to find. It stays red until they are seated. Re-run --set-baseline only to LOWER the other three.
